note: Free public OP Mainnet JSON-RPC endpoints, each verified with eth_chainId returning 0xa, a JSON-RPC batch, eth_feeHistory with reward percentiles, a Multicall3 eth_call, a 10,000-block eth_getLogs window, and logs from the first WETH transfers in block 2179, before the Bedrock upgrade. Endpoints that refused eth_getLogs or capped it below that width, needed a key, or were unreachable were left out, including Sentio's and dRPC's HTTP tiers. Pocket Network's HTTP gateway was left out because it answers an empty list instead of an error for a window older than its pruned history. PublicNode refuses every receipt and any logs outside its recent history with HTTP 403, so receipts and older windows come from the others. The websocket rows carry the newHeads subscription that wakes a sync pass when blocks land, and each was verified by subscribing and receiving a push. The history API row is the Etherscan v2 multichain service, which only serves OP Mainnet under chainid 10 on paid plans. A free key is refused for this chain, and history falls back to logs and balances. Routescan doesn't serve OP Mainnet, and Blockscout's service reports internal transactions it hasn't processed yet, so neither is listed.
